title: Ethereal Ethiopian Delight
description: A flavorful and exotic dish inspired by Ethiopian cuisine, perfect for a dinner gathering. This recipe combines the rich flavors of spices with the simplicity of rice.
instructions: Heat oil in a pan over medium heat.
Add ginger and garlic, sauté for 1 minute.
Add Ethiopian spices, sauté for another minute.
Add rice and stir-fry for 2 minutes.
Add silky sauce, stir-fry for 1 minute.
Transfer to a serving dish and serve hot.
Garnish with fresh herbs, if desired.
Serve with a side of steamed vegetables or salad.
